key_insight: BizGenEval provides the first systematic benchmark that evaluates image-generation models on structured, multi-constraint commercial design tasks rather than just natural-image aesthetics, exposing strengths and failure modes important for real-world visual content creation.
problem_solved: Existing benchmarks target aesthetic or natural-image synthesis and do not measure how well models satisfy the structural, textual, and brand constraints required by commercial visual assets; BizGenEval fills this gap by defining representative tasks and evaluation criteria.
method: Curate a suite of five representative commercial asset categories and associated prompts that encode layout, text, and brand constraints (e.g., composition, typography, required content).

Define multi-constraint evaluation protocols combining automated metrics (layout alignment, OCR/text accuracy, color/brand consistency, fidelity) with targeted human judgments for usability and design quality.
Provide standardized test splits and baseline results to enable systematic comparison and diagnosis of model performance under realistic production constraints.
impact: BizGenEval helps researchers and engineers benchmark and improve generative models for production-ready visual content, accelerating development of models that reliably meet layout, textual, and branding requirements in commercial workflows.
